content.title: About
content.content: A chicken turnover (also known as a hot pocket) is a ready‑to‑heat baked pastry that contains a filling of boiled or roasted chicken breast, vegetables and spices. The product is sealed in a moisture‑proof wrapper and designed for quick preparation in a microwave or conventional oven.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Turnovers were introduced in the United States in the 1970s as a convenient snack for busy people.
The filling often includes a small amount of cheese, which forms a golden crust when heated.
Chicken filling is typically made from skinless breast meat to keep the fat content low.
The product is commonly sold in single‑serve packs of 150‑200 g.
Some brands add whole vegetable pieces to boost nutritional value.

items.title: Protein source
items.content: Chicken provides high‑quality protein essential for muscle growth and tissue repair.

items.title: Low in saturated fat
items.content: Using skinless breast keeps the amount of saturated fat moderate.

items.title: Contains B‑vitamins
items.content: Chicken is rich in vitamin B6 and niacin, which support metabolic processes.

items.title: Convenient and fast
items.content: A turnover can be ready in 2‑3 minutes, making it a practical quick‑meal option.

items.title: Balanced calories
items.content: One serving typically provides 250‑300 kcal, suitable for moderate diets.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Ready‑made products often contain added salt; people monitoring sodium intake should limit portions.

items.title: Allergens
items.content: Recipes may include dairy, gluten, or soy, which are common allergens.

items.title: Thermal safety
items.content: Insufficient heating can leave bacteria alive; heat the product to an internal temperature of at least 75 °C.

items.title: Preservatives
items.content: Preservatives used to extend shelf life may not be suitable for individuals with sensitivities.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the turnover in a microwave (≈ 1.5‑2 minutes on high) or in an oven (≈ 180 °C, 10‑12 minutes). Serve hot, optionally with fresh vegetables, herbs or a dipping sauce.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the unopened package refrigerated at 0‑4 °C. Once opened, consume within 7‑10 days. If frozen, the product retains quality for up to 3 months.
